text:
alex_customer: Hi team — customer on our enterprise plan (acct: ACCT-9921) is asking for confirmation that all PII from a dataset ingested last month was deleted and that the deletion is reflected in audit logs. They say they called the Delete API but still see traces in their S3 backup. Need: (1) data role (processor/controller) confirmation in our DPA, (2) list of sub-processors for EU region, (3) exact deletion steps and proof (audit entries, KMS/HSM rewrap logs). Please advise.
sara_support: Thanks Alex — can you paste the request ID they used and approx time? We'll start a case and escalate to security/legal. :mag_right:
alex_customer: request id is req_0a9f3e, timestamp ~2026-03-09T14:12:03Z. They ran the Delete API -> `DELETE https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingestions/req_0a9f3e` and got `204 No Content`. But customer claims their S3 export still contains rows.
sara_support: Got it. Quick checklist: 1) confirm whether their data was in Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, 2) confirm whether backups/exports are on our managed S3 or customer-managed bucket. @mike_security can you check KMS/HSM rewrap events for that key and whether audit log contains the deletion event?
mike_security: On it. Two quick notes: if they used Private with customer-managed S3, we won't have deletion access to that bucket. If hosted/dedicated we should. I'll pull key usage and audit logs.
infra-bot: deploy-log: audit-indexer job processed 1768451200..1768455000; indexer-id ix-77a2.
mike_security: Found entries for `req_0a9f3e` in our audit-store: `audit.event=ingestion.delete, actor=api-key-usr-124, resource=req_0a9f3e, result=accepted` at 2026-03-09T14:12:03Z. Also KMS envelope key id `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:999:key/abcd-ef01` had a rewrap event 2026-03-09T14:12:05Z. I will attach log snippet below.
mike_security: ```json
{"time":"2026-03-09T14:12:03Z","event":"ingestion.delete","resource":"req_0a9f3e","actor":"api-key-usr-124","result":"accepted"}
{"time":"2026-03-09T14:12:05Z","event":"kms.rewrap","key":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:999:key/abcd-ef01","action":"re-encrypt","status":"success"}```
jules_legal: For DPA roles: per our standard DPA we are a processor; customer controls data subject directions. I'll confirm and paste clause/section. We do list subprocessors in the DPA Addendum — EU infra providers include AWS eu-west-1 and our monitoring vendor (LogMon). I will paste the subprocessor list link.
sara_support: Alex — can you confirm whether customer's S3 export was produced by our `exports` endpoint or by their internal tooling? If they provide the export object id we can map it.
alex_customer: They say it was produced from the Console -> Exports -> CSV (hosted). Export id exp_6031. Timestamp 2026-03-09T14:20Z. They shared a sample CSV that still contains ~120 rows referencing PII.
mike_security: If export occurred after delete, export should have excluded deleted rows. Let's repro locally using same steps and timeline. Repro plan: 1) call `DELETE /v1/ingestions/req_0a9f3e` 2) wait for audit event `ingestion.delete` 3) trigger `POST /v1/exports` for exp_6031 4) inspect export object in our managed S3 (`s3://redwood-exports/eu/exp_6031.csv`) and compare. I just checked: export object for exp_6031 was created at 2026-03-09T14:19:58Z — that's before deletion. That explains why it contains rows.
sara_support: Good catch. So timeline: export created 14:19:58Z, delete at 14:12:03Z? That suggests delete happened earlier. Wait timestamps conflict. Who created export and what timezone? Alex, can you re-check customer's reported timestamps?
alex_customer: They gave local times; apologies. Their console shows export at 15:19 CET which matches 14:19Z. Delete claim was 15:12 CET -> 14:12Z. So export indeed occurred after delete in their timeline.
mike_security: Ok timeline: delete 14:12:03Z, export 14:19:58Z (later) — export should not include deleted rows. Two possibilities: (A) delete only marked ingestion as soft-deleted (logical) and export pipeline reads raw storage, (B) eventual consistency or export job used snapshot before delete propagated. I'll check ingestion backend write path and export snapshot window.
jules_legal: Regardless, for customer's compliance need we should provide: 1) confirmation we performed deletion action (audit event + KMS rewrap) — done, 2) explanation of why export contains rows and remediation (re-run export after reingestion check or purge snapshot), 3) formal DPA clause and subprocessor list plus export of audit lines as proof.
sara_support: Action items: - Mike: compile audit lines, KMS/HSM evidence, and timeline (ETA 2h). - Jules: paste DPA excerpt and subprocessor list + contact for Data Processing Addendum (ETA 3h). - Alex: ask customer to re-run export post-14:25Z or give us a copy of export S3 path.
mike_security: Quick note re KMS/HSM: we don't store raw PII outside customer data blobs; KMS events show rewrap but HSM-level logs are under our HSM vendor — I can request signed attestation if required but expect 24-48h.
alex_customer: Appreciate the clarity. They want a signed attestation for deletion within 48h and an explanation of why export included rows.
jules_legal: We'll prepare a short attestation template and DPA clause extract; legal needs the customer contract id (PID-5587). Alex please supply.
alex_customer: contract PID-5587. Also they asked whether we use any third-party analytics subprocessor that would have copies of processed data (LogMon?).
jules_legal: Confirmed: LogMon only receives aggregated telemetry, not row-level PII. Subprocessor list link: https://redwood.ai/dpa/subprocessors/eu (include in response).
sara_support: I'll draft reply to customer summarizing: audit proof + KMS evidence + reason for export (snapshot timing) + next steps (re-run export or our purge routine) + link to subprocessor list + legal attestation to follow. Posting draft here for review: "Hi — we confirmed deletion action in our audit logs and KMS rewrap. The export you shared was created from a snapshot before the deletion propagated to the export pipeline; re-running the export after 14:25Z should exclude deleted rows. We've attached the audit lines and will provide a signed attestation within 48h. Our DPA lists us as processor; subprocessors: AWS (eu-west-1), LogMon, and CDNCo. Please confirm if you'd like us to re-run the export or schedule a purge of the export object"
mike_security: LGTM, add the audit snippets and the exact S3 object path so they can correlate. Also mention TTL on export snapshots (48h) and that we can forcibly purge managed export objects on request.
jules_legal: Add line: "This attestation is provided subject to the contract terms in PID-5587 and our DPA." Then send.
sara_support: Sending now. I'll keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
alex_customer: Thanks — sending to customer and will escalate if they need signed HSM logs. Will follow up here.
mike_security: Filed security ticket SEQ-1429 to request vendor HSM attestation (ETA 48h).
infra-bot: case-created: CS-7721 assigned to sara_support.
